## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Related issues

Link relevant issues. Use `Closes #123` only when this PR resolves the issue.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Explain any skipped or unavailable checks and the reason.

## Compatibility and documentation

Describe configuration changes, breaking changes, and affected documentation or screenshots.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows the repository's AGENTS.md conventions.
- [ ] Relevant tests, linting, and security checks passed, or limitations are documented above.
- [ ] Affected documentation and examples are up to date.
- [ ] No credentials, production data, private keys, or sensitive endpoints are included.
- [ ] Any new third-party material has documented provenance and a compatible license.
